papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models can generate plausible end-effector motions, yet they often fail in long-horizon, contact-rich tasks because the underlying hand-object interaction (HOI) structure is not explicitly represented. An embodiment-agnostic interaction representation that captures this structure would make manipulation behaviors easier to validate and transfer across robots. We propose FlowHOI, a two-stage flow-matching framework that generates semantically grounded, temporally coherent HOI sequences, comprising hand poses, object poses, and hand-object contact states, conditioned on an egocentric observation, a language instruction, and a 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) scene reconstruction. We decouple geometry-centric grasping from semantics-centric manipulation, conditioning the latter on compact 3D scene tokens and employing a motion-text alignment loss to semantically ground the generated interactions in both the physical scene layout and the language instruction. To address the scarcity of high-fidelity HOI supervision, we introduce a reconstruction pipeline that recovers aligned hand-object trajectories and meshes from large-scale egocentric videos, yielding an HOI prior for robust generation. Across the GRAB and HOT3D benchmarks, FlowHOI achieves the highest action recognition accuracy and a 1.7$\times$ higher physics simulation success rate than the strongest diffusion-based baseline, while delivering a 40$\times$ inference speedup. We further demonstrate real-robot execution on four dexterous manipulation tasks, illustrating the feasibility of retargeting generated HOI representations to real-robot execution pipelines.

analysis.key_results: 在GRAB和HOT3D基准上，FlowHOI获得最高的动作识别准确率，物理模拟成功率比最强扩散基线高1.7倍，推理速度快40倍，并在四个灵巧操作任务上展示了真实机器人执行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FlowHOI，一个两阶段流匹配框架，生成语义基础且时间连贯的手-物交互序列，显式表示手-物交互结构，并通过运动-文本对齐损失和3D场景标记实现语义基础。
analysis.method: 两阶段流匹配框架，解耦几何抓取和语义操作，以第一人称观察、语言指令和3D高斯场景重建为条件，使用3D场景标记和运动-文本对齐损失，以及从大型第一人称视频重建的HOI先验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FlowHOI提出一个两阶段流匹配框架，利用语义动作生成手-物交互（HOI）序列，以实现跨机器人、接触丰富的灵巧操作任务。

papers.abstract: Achieving general-purpose robotic manipulation requires robots to bridge high-level semantic intent with low-level physical interaction in unstructured environments. However, zero-shot generalization remains challenging: end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often lack the precision required for long-horizon tasks, while traditional hierarchical planners suffer from semantic rigidity under open-world variations. We present UniManip, a unified framework centered on an Agentic Operational Graph (AOG), an explicit cognitive and operational backbone for task orchestration, state tracking, execution verification, and closed-loop failure recovery. High-level semantic intents are grounded into actionable primitives via a physically grounded scene graph that provides geometric affordances, contact-aware interaction parameters, and collision-free trajectory synthesis. By coupling a high-level Agentic Layer for task orchestration with a low-level Scene Layer for dynamic state representation, UniManip continuously aligns abstract planning with geometric constraints, enabling robust execution. Unlike static pipelines, UniManip operates as a dynamic agentic loop: it instantiates object-centric scene graphs from unstructured perception, parameterizes these representations into collision-free trajectories via a safety-aware local planner, and exploits structured memory to autonomously diagnose and recover from execution failures. UniManip achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Pro, while extensive real-world experiments demonstrate robust zero-shot generalization across diverse tasks, embodiments, and dexterous hands, outperforming leading VLA models and hierarchical baselines by 22.5% and 25.0% in task success rate, respectively. Open-source project page: https://henryhcliu.github.io/unimanip.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Pro上取得最先进性能；真实世界实验中，任务成功率分别比领先的VLA模型和分层基线高出22.5%和25.0%。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: UniManip提出一个统一框架，利用智能操作图将高层语义意图与低层物理交互桥接起来，实现零样本泛化的机器人操控。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的不足，通过引入智能操作图增强其在长时程任务和开放世界中的鲁棒性，与VLA及机器人世界模型方向高度相关。

papers.abstract: Multimodal action understanding requires complementary sensory observations to be connected with structured semantic knowledge. This is particularly challenging in vehicle cabins, where fine-grained actions exhibit similar upper-body motion, relevant objects may be small or occluded, and appearance varies substantially across illumination conditions. Existing in-cabin datasets, however, rarely provide synchronized visual modalities together with dense object annotations and explicit action--object alignment, limiting the study of object-grounded multimodal recognition. To address this gap, we introduce the Driver Action with Object Synergy (DAOS) dataset, containing 9,787 video clips, 36 fine-grained actions, 15 object categories, and more than 2.5 million annotated object instances. DAOS provides synchronized RGB, infrared, and depth observations from four camera views, thereby combining complementary appearance, low-light, and geometric information. Building on DAOS, we propose the Action-Object-Relation Network (AOR-Net), a vision-language framework that organizes multimodal understanding at three semantic levels: action, object, and human-object relation. Its Chain-of-action Prompting mechanism progressively grounds global motion with localized object and relation cues, while a textual prototype bank supplies corresponding semantic descriptions. A Mixture of Thoughts module then dynamically selects and integrates the most informative semantic levels and visual modalities under object-rich and object-scarce conditions. Extensive experiments show that AOR-Net consistently outperforms strong baselines on DAOS, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining heterogeneous visual sensing with structured action-object-relation semantics for fine-grained multimodal video understanding.

analysis.key_results: AOR-Net 在 DAOS 上一致优于强基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 DAOS 数据集（9,787 视频片段、36 种细粒度动作、15 类物体、超 250 万物体实例标注），并提出 AOR-Net 视觉-语言框架。

papers.abstract: Robust robotic manipulation requires reliable failure detection and recovery. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show promise in robot failure detection, their generalization is severely limited by the scarcity and narrow coverage of failure data. To address this bottleneck, we propose an automatic framework for generating diverse robotic planning and execution failures across both simulated and real-world environments. Our approach perturbs successful manipulation trajectories to synthesize failures that reflect realistic failure distributions, and leverages VLMs to produce structured step-by-step reasoning traces. This yields GuardianFail-36k, a large-scale failure reasoning dataset built upon the RLBench simulator and the BridgeDataV2 real-robot dataset. Using GuardianFail-36k, we train Guardian, a multi-view reasoning VLM for unified planning and execution verification. Guardian achieves state-of-the-art performance on three unseen real-world benchmarks: RoboFail, RoboVQA, and our newly introduced UR5-Fail. When integrated with a state-of-the-art LLM-based manipulation policy, it consistently boosts task success rates in both simulation and real-world deployment. These results demonstrate that scaling high-quality failure reasoning data is critical for improving generalization in robotic failure detection. Code, Data, and Models are available at https://www.di.ens.fr/willow/research/guardian/.

analysis.key_results: 在三个未见过的真实世界基准（RoboFail、RoboVQA、UR5-Fail）上达到SOTA；集成到SOTA LLM操作策略后，在仿真和真实部署中均提升任务成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出自动生成机器人规划与执行失败数据的框架；构建GuardianFail-36k数据集；训练Guardian模型，在多个真实世界基准上取得SOTA，并能提升LLM操作策略的成功率。
analysis.method: 扰动成功操作轨迹以合成符合真实分布的失败数据；利用VLM生成结构化逐步推理轨迹；基于RLBench和BridgeDataV2构建GuardianFail-36k；训练多视角推理VLM（Guardian）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出自动生成机器人失败推理数据的框架，构建大规模数据集GuardianFail-36k，并训练一个多视角推理VLM（Guardian）以实现统一的规划与执行验证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向机器人失败检测与恢复，属于VLA（视觉-语言-动作）框架下的验证与推理模块，增强机器人策略的可靠性和泛化能力，核心贡献是失败推理数据与模型。

papers.abstract: Camera-controlled video generation has attracted increasing interest for its applications in simulation, gaming, and world modeling. However, current models often deform rigid objects and scene structure as the viewpoint changes. We investigate whether this failure is related to a measurable internal property: the view consistency of diffusion representations. Across a diverse collection of camera-controlled image-to-video diffusion models, we find that models exhibiting more view-consistent representations generate videos with superior 3D consistency. We complement this correlation-based evidence with a within-model controlled intervention, ViCoDR, which directly supervises the view consistency of internal diffusion representations, during training. Across camera-controlled image-to-video, camera-controlled text-to-video, and multi-view generation tasks, ViCoDR consistently improves output 3D consistency. Finally, we evaluate the loss used for these interventions as an auxiliary training objective by retraining a camera-controlled I2V model using either ViCoDR or existing methods for supervising diffusion representations under the same training setup. We show that the ViCoDR loss improves output 3D consistency more reliably than the alternatives and remains effective across design variants, while exhibiting camera-control trade-offs and requiring additional training computation. Together, these results establish view consistency of internal diffusion representations as an important property for analyzing and improving camera-controlled video generation. Project page: https://danier97.github.io/ViCoDR.

analysis.key_results: 视一致性更高的模型产生更优3D一致性；ViCoDR在I2V、T2V和多视图生成任务中一致提高输出3D一致性；ViCoDR损失比现有方法更可靠，但存在相机控制权衡和额外训练计算。
analysis.limitations: 存在相机控制权衡，且需要额外训练计算。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现扩散内部表征的视一致性可预测相机控制视频生成的3D一致性，并提出直接监督该一致性的干预方法ViCoDR，在多个任务上一致改善输出3D一致性。
analysis.method: 对多种相机控制I2V模型进行相关性分析；设计训练干预ViCoDR直接监督内部扩散表征的视一致性；并在相同训练设置下与现有方法对比损失函数效果。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文探究扩散模型内部表征的视一致性与相机控制视频生成中3D一致性之间的关联，并提出训练干预方法ViCoDR来提升输出一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究面向相机控制视频生成，属于世界建模的视觉生成方向，可为机器人仿真和世界模型的构建提供更一致的视频数据，但未直接涉及VLA或机器人动作预测。

papers.abstract: Post-training LLM compression often relies on low-rank approximations, which force all columns of a projection matrix to share a single low-dimensional subspace. We propose CoSpaDi, a training-free compression framework that replaces this single-subspace assumption with a union-of-subspaces model via sparse dictionary learning. CoSpaDi factorizes each weight matrix into a dense dictionary and column-sparse coefficients, allowing different columns to select different subsets of dictionary atoms at the same storage budget. To preserve model behavior, we use calibration activations to transform functional reconstruction into a standard dictionary learning problem. Across LLaMA and Qwen models, CoSpaDi improves accuracy-compression and perplexity-compression trade-offs over SVD-based and structured pruning baselines at 20-40\% compression ratios, while naturally supporting sparse-dense computation and post-training quantization of sparse coefficients.

analysis.key_results: 在 LLaMA 和 Qwen 模型上，在 20-40% 压缩率下，CoSpaDi 相比基于 SVD 和结构化剪枝的基线改善了精度-压缩率和困惑度-压缩率权衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CoSpaDi 压缩框架，用稀疏字典学习的并集子空间模型替代单一低秩假设，实现更好的精度-压缩率权衡，并自然支持稀疏稠密计算和后训练量化。
analysis.method: 使用校准激活将功能重建转化为标准字典学习问题，将每个权重矩阵分解为稠密字典和列稀疏系数。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoSpaDi 提出一种免训练的低秩压缩框架，通过稀疏字典学习将权重矩阵分解为稠密字典与列稀疏系数，以在相同存储预算下提升压缩后模型性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型的高效压缩与量化，未直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人领域；其稀疏字典学习和量化技术可作为通用模型压缩方法，对 VLA/WAM 等模型的高效推理具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: While reasoning technology like Chain of Thought (CoT) has been widely adopted in Vision Language Action (VLA) models, it demonstrates promising capabilities in end to end autonomous driving. However, recent efforts to integrate CoT reasoning often fall short in simple scenarios, introducing unnecessary computational overhead without improving decision quality. To address this, we propose AdaThinkDrive, a novel VLA framework with a dual mode reasoning mechanism inspired by fast and slow thinking. First, our framework is pretrained on large scale autonomous driving (AD) scenarios using both question answering (QA) and trajectory datasets to acquire world knowledge and driving commonsense. During supervised fine tuning (SFT), we introduce a two mode dataset, fast answering (w/o CoT) and slow thinking (with CoT), enabling the model to distinguish between scenarios that require reasoning. Furthermore, an Adaptive Think Reward strategy is proposed in conjunction with the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which rewards the model for selectively applying CoT by comparing trajectory quality across different reasoning modes. Extensive experiments on the Navsim benchmark show that AdaThinkDrive achieves a PDMS of 90.3, surpassing the best vision only baseline by 1.7 points. Moreover, ablations show that AdaThinkDrive surpasses both the never Think and always Think baselines, improving PDMS by 2.0 and 1.4, respectively. It also reduces inference time by 14% compared to the always Think baseline, demonstrating its ability to balance accuracy and efficiency through adaptive reasoning.

analysis.key_results: 在Navsim基准上达到PDMS 90.3，超过最佳纯视觉基线1.7分；相比从不思考和总是思考基线，PDMS分别提高2.0和1.4；推理时间比总是思考基线减少14%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AdaThinkDrive，一个带有快速和慢速双模式推理机制的VLA框架，通过自适应思维奖励与GRPO结合，使模型能选择性应用思维链。
analysis.method: 在大规模自动驾驶场景上预训练（问答和轨迹数据），SFT阶段使用双模式数据集（无CoT快速回答和有CoT慢速思考），并提出Adaptive Think Reward策略与GRPO优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个双模式推理的VLA框架，通过强化学习自适应地决定何时使用思维链，以在自动驾驶中平衡准确性和效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接改进VLA模型在自动驾驶中的推理效率，通过自适应思维链减少不必要的计算，对机器人策略学习和高效推理具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Splat-based radiance fields have rapidly diversified in primitive type, kernel support, and appearance parameterization. This diversity makes compression difficult: most codecs are single-rate, requiring a separately optimized model for each target bitrate, while progressive codecs remain tied to representation-specific assumptions that do not transfer across backbones. We introduce GoDe (Gaussians on Demand), a progressive compression framework whose central contribution is backbone agnosticism. It reorganizes any trained differentiable splat representation into a single scalable bitstream without modifying the backbone or re-deriving the compression structure for each new primitive type. GoDe builds a nested level-of-detail hierarchy via masked-gradient importance ranking, refines all levels with one quantization-aware fine-tuning stage, and stores the base layer and enhancement layers as progressive chunks compressed with shared entropy dictionaries. Any decoded prefix is directly renderable, so one training pipeline provides multiple rate-distortion operating points without per-rate retraining. Across five heterogeneous backbones and three standard benchmarks, GoDe achieves competitive rate-distortion performance while enabling faster rendering and substantially faster progressive decoding than existing methods. Project page: https://gaussians-on-demand.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在五个异构主干和三个标准基准上，GoDe 在率失真性能上具有竞争力，同时渲染速度更快，渐进解码速度显著快于现有方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出主干无关的渐进压缩框架 GoDe，通过掩码梯度重要性排序构建嵌套层次细节，结合一次性量化感知微调和共享熵字典的渐进码流，实现无需按率重训的多码率压缩。
analysis.method: 掩码梯度重要性排序构建嵌套层次细节，量化感知微调优化所有层级，存储为渐进分块并使用共享熵字典压缩。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GoDe 提出一种主干无关的渐进压缩框架，可将任意可微分裂表示组织为单一可扩展比特流，无需修改主干或按新基元重新推导压缩结构。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对分裂基辐射场的压缩，与 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或 WAM（世界模型）无直接关系，但其量化感知渐进压缩框架对高效推理具有方法学参考价值。
